description: Single-user, local-first personal media system with metadata scraping, library management and browser access
notes: Data (config, database, cache) is stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Peach\peach-data, outside the app directory; upgrading or uninstalling this package keeps it.
Upgrade with 'scoop update peach'. The built-in updater rewrites files managed by Scoop, so turn off automatic update downloads in Settings > App and Maintenance.
